description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Queue Stream Provider configuration builder in an Orleans-based project. It verifies different configuration scenarios such as missing connection strings, minimal valid configurations, and full configurations with all options set.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderBuilderTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for Azure Queue Stream Provider configuration.

classes.name: TestSiloBuilder
classes.description: A helper class implementing ISiloBuilder to facilitate configuration setup for tests.

methods.name: Missing_ConnectionString
methods.description: Test verifying behavior when connection string is missing; expects QueueServiceClient to be null.

methods.name: Minimal_Configuration
methods.description: Test verifying that minimal configuration creates a valid QueueServiceClient with default settings.

methods.name: Full_Configuration
methods.description: Test verifying that all configuration options are correctly parsed and applied.

methods.name: ConfigureSilo
methods.description: Helper method to set up a silo builder with given JSON configuration.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Static method to create IConfigurationRoot from JSON string.
